73.description: These tokens represent various characters and consonants from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Nepali.

90.description: This feature detects Devanagari script characters and sub-word tokens commonly found in Hindi text encoding.

76.description: This vector represents common Hindi consonants, consonant clusters, and vowel-consonant combinations.

185.description: These tokens represent common combining vowel signs and consonant-vowel characters from the Devanagari script.

79.description: These tokens represent common prefixes, roots, and numerals frequently occurring in Hindi text.

24.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi devanagari consonant conjuncts and sub-word fragments.

125.description: This vector activates on various forms of the Hindi vowel sign 'e' (े) and common character combinations containing it.

183.description: This vector is related to subword tokens starting with Devanagari vowel and consonant characters.

49.description: This vector represents sequential numbers, specifically within the one-hundred-eighties range.

35.description: This feature vector represents Hindi conditional and temporal conjunctions, interrogatives, and related grammatical morphemes.
